description: This file defines the CustomerOption class, representing customer options with properties like type, name, default value, and available values. It extends ShopEntity and implements Serializable, serving as a data model within the customer attribute package.

classes.name: CustomerOption
classes.description: Represents a customer option with a type, name, default value, and list of available values, extending ShopEntity and implementing Serializable.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Retrieves the type of the customer option.

methods.description: Sets the type of the customer option.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the customer option.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the customer option.

methods.name: getDefaultValue
methods.description: Gets the default value for this customer option.

methods.name: setDefaultValue
methods.description: Sets the default value for this customer option.

methods.name: getAvailableValues
